memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Israel, however, put him to the sword and took over his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, but only as far as the Ammonites, because their border was fortified. Israel captured all the cities of the Amorites and occupied them, including Heshbon and all its surrounding settlements. - Num 21:24-25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Sihon chose war, and the outcome was decisive. Israel prevailed and took possession of the Amorite land, city by city. After so many years in the wilderness, the people were beginning to see God fulfil His ancient promise to give them a land.

We should read this rightly. This was a specific act within God's plan for that time and place, the moment when a long-promised inheritance began to take shape. It is not a template for how we advance today, for our warfare is not against flesh and blood. The lesson that carries forward is that God keeps His word.

For decades, the Promised Land had been a hope on the horizon, delayed by unbelief and hard years. Yet God had not forgotten. His promises are never cancelled by our delays; they wait for His perfect timing. What He speaks, He surely brings to pass.

Are you waiting on a promise of God that seems long overdue? Take heart from Heshbon. The God who kept His word to Israel keeps His word to us in Christ, in whom every one of God's promises finds its yes (2 Cor 1:20). His timing is not our timing, but His faithfulness never fails.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you believe God keeps His promises even when they are delayed?
2. How does God's faithfulness to Israel encourage your own waiting?
3. What promise of God do you need to hold onto today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, thank You that Your promises never fail and every one finds its yes in Christ. Strengthen my faith to keep trusting You even in the waiting. Amen.
